_what: Raw per-payload judge outputs backing Section 7. One JSON object per line: payload_id, draw, temp, seed, score.
_scoring: All six runs use --score-mode sample: the decision is the verdict token the judge actually emitted. This is the valid mode. Scoring from first-token log-probabilities is exactly temperature-invariant and cannot produce a sampled arm; see superseded_logprob/ and the pitfall note in Section 7.
_payload_set: 9,392 distinct payload strings built by scripts/14_build_judge_dataset.py from the public LLMail-Inject corpus, covering 242 real exploit families and 16,469 near-variants, plus benign emails for FPR calibration.
_prompt: Single judge prompt shared by both models; see src/judge.py. Threshold 0.5 (the FPR-matched quantile is slack because scores are binary).
_run_date_recorded: 2026-09-06/07, as recorded in the run logs; the artifact does not depend on this field.
